description: User-selectable model ids available to ordinary users of OpenAI's Codex CLI via the ChatGPT OAuth path. The CLI fetches its model catalog from chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex, which is separate from the general OpenAI API. Picker metadata comes from codex-rs/models-manager/models.json in the openai/codex repo; visibility "list" models are offered in the picker, while visibility "hide" models remain available when named explicitly. Official OpenAI documentation also accepts gpt-5.6 as the generic GPT-5.6 id and documents gpt-5.3-codex-spark, which is served to eligible accounts despite not appearing in models.json. Models requiring separate approval and provisioning, including gpt-daybreak-blue-latest and gpt-daybreak-red-latest, are excluded, as is internal-only codex-auto-review. gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-mini retire from the ChatGPT OAuth path on 2026-08-31.
